LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Roma.label: testudo drill
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Roma.description:
Legionaries close ranks and lock their shields into a roof. Packed together they shrug off arrows and blows, but they march slowly.
The more comrades stand within three cells, the stronger it is.
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Roma.stages.0.label: broken ranks
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Roma.stages.1.label: loose line
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Roma.stages.2.label: shield roof
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Hellas.label: phalanx drill
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Hellas.description:
Hoplites fight shoulder to shoulder, each shield covering the man to the left. In the line they are hard to hit and hard to escape; alone they are ordinary men.
The more comrades stand within three cells, the stronger it is.
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Hellas.stages.0.label: broken line
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Hellas.stages.1.label: loose phalanx
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Hellas.stages.2.label: closed phalanx
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Nord.label: strandhogg drill
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Nord.description:
The shore raid: no siege and no waiting. Raiders cut through walls with axes and run at the enemy, fast, fierce and hard to stop with pain.
It lasts while the raider fights for the raid.
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Nord.stages.0.label: raider's fury
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Yamato.label: bushido drill
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Yamato.description:
Samurai attack in small bands from several sides at once and pick their targets with care. Calm in the face of death, they fight on through wounds.
It lasts while the raider fights for the raid.
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Yamato.stages.0.label: way of the warrior
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Tianxia.label: art of war drill
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Tianxia.description:
Every battle is won before it is fought. Tianxia armies gather out of reach, wait for the right moment and then strike with drilled crossbow volleys.
It lasts while the raider fights for the raid.
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Tianxia.stages.0.label: drilled volleys
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Albion.label: siege train drill
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Albion.description:
Albion comes with spades and guns. Its armies often dig in and build a battery before they attack, and its riflemen fire steady, measured volleys.
It lasts while the raider fights for the raid.
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Albion.stages.0.label: volley fire
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Kemet.label: chariot vanguard drill
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Kemet.description:
Kemet's attack opens with speed: the vanguard runs ahead as the chariots once did and is on the walls before the defenders are ready.
It lasts while the raider fights for the raid.
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Kemet.stages.0.label: vanguard's speed
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Pars.label: cavalry wings drill
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Pars.description:
The armies of Pars attack on the wings: several swift groups at once, used to fighting from the saddle and closing in fast.
It lasts while the raider fights for the raid.
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Pars.stages.0.label: rider's charge
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Inti.label: mountain sappers drill
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Inti.description:
The road builders of the Andes go through rock rather than around it. Inti raiders dig toward your walls and throw stones with mountain-trained aim.
It lasts while the raider fights for the raid.
LanguageData.HE_Doctrine_Inti.stages.0.label: mountain stride
